description: Founded in 1995 in San Jose, California, eBay Inc. is a global commerce leader that connects people and builds communities to create economic opportunity for all. Its technology empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world, and its Marketplace platforms, including its online marketplace and localized counterparts, its off-platform marketplaces and its suite of mobile apps, together create one of the world's largest and most vibrant marketplaces for discovering great value and a unique selection, enabling nearly $80 billion of Gross Merchandise Volume in 2025. As a global commerce leader and third-party marketplace, its technologies and services are designed to provide buyers choice and a breadth of relevant inventory.
